submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One independent animation sprite, native1254x1254 true transparent RGBA. Image1 is the exact Moon Shadow Girl RUN NORTHWEST frame15 edit target. Image2 is her NW13: use only its narrower lengthwise sole and clean calf-to-heel axis as a reference. Image3 is approved project rendering style.
Make ONE very local anatomy correction: the lowest boot at screen lower-right (the extended RIGHT support leg, late rear propulsion) has a conspicuous sideways hook in its forefoot, folding toward screen-left away from its calf/heel longitudinal plane. Redraw only this boot and the tiny ankle join so the sole is a slim, smoothly continuous heel-to-toe shape aligned with the existing rearward leg and the NW running plane. Reduce lateral yaw/roll and the jutting sideways toe; let the sole recede naturally as in image2. It must look like a straight rear-view running boot, not a curved J-foot or sideways skating boot. Keep natural ankle extension and raised heel; this is late FOREFOOT support, not a flat whole-sole landing. Preserve the ground-contact level and perspective, foot/ankle location, calf length, knee angle, support-leg identity and the other lifted leg. Do not move or straighten the whole leg and do not turn the entire character. This is frame15, not a replacement with frame13.
Strict invariants: preserve all of image1 except the specified boot/ankle detail, particularly exact fullcanvas scale and framing, silver hair/head placement, NW view, hair ornament, torso lean, hips, upper/lower legs, near lifted boot, scarf/tails, gold/navy clothing, both arms, both hands and two separate crescent daggers. No whole-body shift or scale. Do not mirror, duplicate or add limbs. Keep navy leather, warm gold edging and current sole material. No floor, ground line, shadow, effects, text, checkerboard, UI or opaque background. Actual transparent alpha, complete character safely inside all canvas edges. Highest available native fidelity.
